environment.name: Deep Sky — Sagittarius A* and background

cues.text: BETTERMAN: LARK–4C. Navigation check. Holding course.
FLIGHT COMPUTER: Caution. Gravitational gradient increasing.
BETTERMAN: That is not a shadow. Full reverse thrust.
FLIGHT COMPUTER: Tidal load exceeded. Port wing separation.
BETTERMAN: Mayday. LARK–4C. We are losing the ship.
BETTERMAN: If anyone can hear this—
